name: Solar Return Reading
purpose: A yearly reading around your birthday: your solar return chart brings the coming year's themes into focus and shows where the next chapter may ask for more of your attention.
method: I read the solar return chart in relationship with your natal chart, looking for the themes and areas of emphasis that stand out for the year ahead. Your intake form tells me what is already on your mind so the conversation can stay connected to the life you are living.
bestFor: An annual check-in around your birthday
Established clients who want a broader view of the year ahead
Seeing which themes may deserve more attention as a new personal year begins
notFor: A first reading. Start with the Natal Chart Reading; this builds on the natal foundation we have already established
intakeRequirements: Your focus for the year, via the intake form
includes: Your solar return chart and the patterns that stand out within it
The themes and areas of emphasis for your personal year
How the solar return chart relates back to your natal chart
preparation: Book near your birthday for best effect
Note the areas of life you most want the year read for
